thread:
sophie-sales: Hey folks — ACME's POC runs a stress demo tomorrow 10:00 PT. They expect short bursts of ~120 reqs/sec for ~5 mins. Can we get a temporary hosted quota bump on the demo key?
kevin-se: @sophie-sales how big are the responses? avg tokens/request?
sophie-sales: Avg ~800 tokens on generation, some chat messages are ~1200. They'll only hit the burst window for ~5 minutes, then steady 2–3 rps.
harry-eng-infra: Do we have their org/account id and the API key id? Need that to scope a scoped key with an explicit quota. Billing note: sustained 120 rps with 800 tokens is non-trivial.
sophie-sales: Org: acme-inc-42, demo key id will be provided in 5m. They want hosted fallback only, no Dedicated for the demo.
olivia-ops: We can create a scoped key with short TTL + enforced token limit and rate cap. Propose: 150 rps burst, 1k token cap per request, window 10 minutes, expires in 12 hours. That keeps risk low.
jess-soleng: Will run a smoke test at 09:30 PT and a full demo at 10:00. Can we set a soft quota of 150 rps with automatic rollback to 10 rps after 10 minutes?
harry-eng-infra: We don't have automatic rollback for hosted quotas yet, but we can schedule a manual revert. Or create a script to call the internal quota API at TIMESTAMP to lower it.
kevin-se: If you want automation, I can add a tiny Cloud Function to flip it back at 10:15 PT. It just needs the quota request id.
sophie-sales: That would be ideal, @kevin-se. We'll send the key id and exact times in the next message.
quota-bot: New quota request created: Q-2026-9923 by sophie-sales for org acme-inc-42. Requested increase: 150 rps, 1M tokens/min limit, TTL 12h. Please tag eng-infra for approval.
harry-eng-infra: Approving pending key id and confirmation of test script. Also, pinging finance: this will temporarily increase expected usage charges.
olivia-ops: Sample scoped-key policy I can apply (will set expiry and usage cap):
```json
{
  "scopes": ["generation"],
  "rate_limit": {"burst": 150, "steady": 10},
  "token_cap": 1000000,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-21T22:00:00Z"
}
```
kevin-se: Perfect. For the smoke test I'll run:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"demo","max_tokens":800}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```
kevin-se: I'll cap concurrency to avoid an accidental runaway.
sophie-sales: Sending key id now: key-89a2. Demo start 10:00 PT, smoke 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone :pray:
harry-eng-infra: Applied scoped key policy to key-89a2. Quota request Q-2026-9923 marked APPROVED. I've scheduled a manual rollback window at 10:20 PT; @kevin-se if you want automation let me know.
jess-soleng: Got it — I'll be on the call. If anything trips, we'll fail open to the lower tier and continue the demo (no hard outage).
olivia-ops: Noted. I'll watch billing alerts and spike dashboards during the demo.
kevin-se: I'll push the Cloud Function to revert at 10:15 and test it after the smoke run.
sophie-sales: Amazing — truly appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
quota-bot: Q-2026-9923 status update: APPROVED by harry-eng-infra at 2026-03-21T09:12:05Z. Scoped key policy attached.
